reason: Current GitHub Actions exposes historical workflow authorities that are no longer the current execution model. The first bounded closure retires the two frozen A6 reviewed-candidate workflows and the historical WP-A promotion workflow bound to PR #5, while preserving their immutable commits/runs as evidence. Current ACV2 executes current-head A2-A8 authority/runtime/source-closure and legacy SQLite fencing regressions on Ubuntu and Windows; layered-ci-task retains the portable A6 suite; wp-a-post-merge-validation validates current integration identity/source closure and reports readiness without granting release/publish authority. The implementation changes only the historical workflow surfaces, the Layered trigger that still names them, and three contracts that currently require those stale workflows. No product runtime, dependency, release, publish, historical evidence deletion, or new CI infrastructure is authorized.

Current main still contains wp-a-promotion-authorization.yml bound to historical PR #5, so the retirement contract must fail until current readiness responsibility is proven on wp-a-post-merge-validation.yml and the stale workflow surface is removed.
